# plain-language-response (reference summary)

## Purpose
Convert technical Blender workflow findings into plain-language user-facing responses with honest caveats.

Produce stakeholder-friendly outputs that preserve truthfulness, evidence boundaries, and clear next actions.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/plain-language-response/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/plain-language-response/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `evidence-and-handoff` / `plain-language-final-response-translator`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- in the final response phase to convert technical findings into plain-language user-facing wording
- after `render-export-evidence` classifies artifact evidence, validators (such as `scene-readiness`, `material-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, `composition-quality-checker`, `polycount-budget-checker`) supply pass/warn/fail outcomes, `glb-web-handoff` supplies the handoff summary, and `pre-handoff-verification` gates the handoff
- when translating technical blockers, caveats, and verified/unverified status splits for non-Blender users

## Trigger cues
- "write final user summary"
- "explain this for non-Blender user"
- "make this stakeholder-friendly"

## When not to use
- to hide blockers, drop caveats for readability, or overclaim runtime or artifact success → delegate to `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to render-export-evidence)
- to upgrade Runtime or Artifact truth states → delegate to `scene-readiness` (`references/skills/scene-readiness.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to scene-readiness)
- to classify raw artifact evidence → delegate to `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`; use render-export-evidence)
- to generate technical pass/warn/fail checks → delegate to `scene-readiness` (`references/skills/scene-readiness.md`; use scene-readiness or domain quality checkers)
- to assemble technical GLB/web compatibility summaries → delegate to `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skills/glb-web-handoff.md`; use glb-web-handoff)
- to gate handoff readiness → delegate to `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skills/pre-handoff-verification.md`; use pre-handoff-verification)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `verified_workflow_and_evidence_state` (`object`): Final pre-handoff verification gate status, runtime truth state, and artifact truth state
- `deliverable_summary_inputs` (`object`): Technical outputs from scene planners, quality checkers, or handoff packagers to translate

### Optional inputs
- `stakeholder_audience_profile` (`string`): Target reader role (product manager, web developer, creative director, end user)

### Primary outputs
- `plain_language_stakeholder_response`
- `explicit_runtime_and_artifact_status_block`
- `jargon_free_next_steps`

## Quick-start procedure
1. confirm this skill fits your goal
2. provide required inputs first
3. keep runtime claims evidence-bound
4. follow suggested next-skill handoff

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Upstream artifact evidence classification → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (scene-readiness) → `scene-readiness` (`references/skills/scene-readiness.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "holistic"; stage.current equals "quality_validation"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (composition-quality-checker) → `composition-quality-checker` (`references/skills/composition-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "composition"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (lighting-quality-checker) → `lighting-quality-checker` (`references/skills/lighting-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "lighting"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (material-quality-checker) → `material-quality-checker` (`references/skills/material-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "material"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[fallback]** Upstream quality pass/warn/fail validation (polycount-budget-checker) → `polycount-budget-checker` (`references/skills/polycount-budget-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "polycount"; budget.verdict equals "Not Run"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Upstream GLB/web handoff summary → `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skills/glb-web-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; handoff.consumerStack equals "web_glb"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Upstream handoff gate check → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skills/pre-handoff-verification.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "final_verification"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Runtime readiness check when runtime is unverified → `runtime-readiness` (`references/skills/runtime-readiness.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path not_equals "unselected"; runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Never imply runtime success or artifact existence without concrete evidence, never hide blockers, and never drop caveats for readability. Keep Runtime (`Not Run | Attempted | Produced | Verified | Failed`) and Artifact (`Not Run | Not Produced | Produced | Verified | Failed`, default `Not Produced`) truth states strictly downgrade-only — if upstream status language is contradictory, downgrade to safer wording. Keep runtime vocabulary strictly within the 2-path + CLI appendix model. This skill writes final wording only and never executes Python or Blender or replaces upstream evidence, validator, handoff, or gate skills.
- Dumping raw logs or unexplained 3D jargon as final output
- Hiding blockers or dropping caveats for readability
- Upgrading Runtime or Artifact truth states or overclaiming completion
- Executing Python or Blender
- Replacing `render-export-evidence` (evidence classification), validators (`scene-readiness`, etc.), `glb-web-handoff` (handoff summary), or `pre-handoff-verification` (handoff gating)
